decision: memory measurement rejected; timing receipts preserved but excluded from the final paired comparison
reason: All six wait4 observations are 41,004 KiB. The collector first read entire executable snapshots while hashing them and then forked each run; the launcher resident-memory floor masked the benchmark peak. A small C launcher and independent low/high-memory controls replace this path.
method: Python subprocess.Popen followed by os.wait4; per-child counters, with an excessive pre-exec footprint.
